help-center.purpose: Help users find support content through search, category navigation, article state, tags, empty states, and recovery without leaving product context.
useWhen: A product surface needs searchable help, FAQs, onboarding guidance, or support articles.
Content has categories, tags, keywords, and article detail.
Search, no-result recovery, and navigation behavior need consistent ownership.
doNotUseWithoutReview: The content is a single static help block.
Search has no keywords, tags, empty state, or recovery path.
Article content, support routing, or localization ownership is unclear.
The pattern duplicates product navigation instead of supporting help content.
foundations: Defines category/sidebar layout, article width, search placement, and responsive stack.
Owns article titles, category labels, no-result copy, tags, and support escalation language.
Controls selected article, search focus, category state, and result emphasis.
Searching, results, no results, article selected, loading, and support escalation states are explicit.
Tags and keywords provide compact metadata for discovery.
Search label, navigable categories, article headings, focus movement, and no-result announcement are required.
slots: Searches title, body, tags, and keywords.
Grouped navigation with article counts or section labels.
Flat result list when search is active.
Selected article content with title, body, tags, and support links.
No-result recovery with clear next step.
Desktop can use sidebar; mobile stacks or uses drawer.
variants: Categories expand while no search is active.
Search switches to flat ranked results.
Article content, tags, and related support actions.
Category navigation moves to drawer or stacked index.
motion: Results update without page jump; reduced motion removes reveal animation.
Uses system disclosure motion and keeps focus stable.
Moves focus to article heading after user selection.
accessibility: Search has a visible or visually hidden label.
Selected article heading receives focus after navigation.
No results are announced and include recovery.
Support escalation links are explicit and not hidden behind icon-only controls.
tests: Search matches title, tag, and keyword content.
Article selection updates heading and focus.
Mobile layout keeps search and article access visible.
Localization can replace article/category text without layout breakage.

canDecide: Use Help Center when content categories, articles, tags, and search behavior are defined.
Choose category browse or search result mode from user intent.
Expose support escalation when self-service cannot answer.
mustAsk: Content ownership, article source, localization, support routing, or search ranking is unclear.
The help content includes legal, billing, medical, safety, or compliance instructions.
rejectIf: Articles are unstructured blobs without headings or tags.
miel.handoff: Confirm article source, category model, keyword/tag strategy, no-result recovery, support escalation, localization, and mobile navigation.
